framing.title: Before we begin
framing.body:
You are the THIRD PERSON in this conversation.
Please pay attention to the EYE MOVEMENT behavior of the characters, especially when the speaker changes. You will be asked some questions after each conversation, please say your answer out loud.
There are 5 groups * 3 versions.

Next: questions preview.

perClipItems.text: The characters' eye movements looked natural.
The characters' eye movements around the speaker changes felt well-timed.
The characters looked at each other as if they were paying attention to each other.
The characters seemed aware that I was there.

ranking.prompt: Rank the three versions by how natural the characters' eye movements were.

comment.prompt: Did any version feel uncomfortable or unsettling to watch? Which, and why? (optional)

closing.title: That was the last conversation
closing.body: Thank you. Please stay still while the headset is taken off. There are a few short questions to finish, on paper.
